mrPolicy: Kusungidwa pa chipangizochi kudutsa reloads kwa masiku 7: 20 otumiza, 20 envulopu aliyense, 100 okwana, 2 MiB okwana (128 KiB pa envulopu). Mauthenga ochulukirapo ndi mafoni osafunsidwa amagwetsedwa. Palibe chomwe chimatulutsidwa kapena kuwonetseratu chisanavomerezedwe.

mrFailed: Sindinathe kusintha zopempha za uthenga. Chonde yesaninso.
daLinked: Chipangizo cholumikizidwa chomwe sichinawonedwe kale (siginecha ya mizu yatsimikiziridwa)

daUnavailable: Kufufuza ntchito ya akaunti sikupezeka kapena kosakwanira. Kulandirana kungakhale kukana ntchito. Uwu si umboni wa chipangizo chatsopano.
daLimit: Ntchito yosainidwa, yowonedwa yokha ikhoza kutsimikiziridwa. Kulandirana kumatha kusunga zolemba. Malipoti a gawo ndi kukankhira amafuna makasitomala owonjezera, ogwirizana.
daRecovery: Kusagwirizana kumachotsa makiyi ovomerezeka a chipangizo pa anzawo okhoza pambuyo poti malo oyang'anira omwe adasainidwa afika; anzawo a cholowa amangosiya fan-out. Chizindikiritso chokopera kapena kulembetsa kukankha sikungachotsedwe kutali pano: bwezeretsani pa chizindikiritso chatsopano, dziwitsani anthu omwe akugwirizana nawo ndikusiya kugwiritsa ntchito chizindikiritso chosokonezedwa.
cvCompare: Yerekezerani nambalayi pazida zonse ziwiri. Zimaphatikizapo makiyi onse achinsinsi ndi kusainira:
cvMissingPin: Chinsinsi chosaina chokhomedwa chikufunika. Sinthani uthenga wotsimikizika poyamba.

cvStrict: Kuletsa kutumiza pambuyo pa kusintha kwa kiyi mpaka kutsimikiziridwanso
cvFailed: Kutsimikiziridwa kunalephera kapena makiyi adasinthidwa poyerekeza. Tsegulaninso ndikuyerekezanso.
cvBlocked: Kutumiza kutsekedwa: makiyi olumikizana adasinthidwa. Yerekezerani manambala achitetezo ndikutsimikiziranso, kapena zimitsani njira yokhwima mu /verify.
vaultUnlock: Lowani mawu osiyana a vault passphrase

vaultScope: Tetezani makiyi, mauthenga / mafayilo, olumikizana, zolemba ndi makonzedwe a osatsegula payekha pa maakaunti onse? Sungani mawu anu achire ndi fayilo ya vault yosungira poyamba. Mutu, chilankhulo ndi chilolezo zimakhala pagulu. /vault loko kumatseka tabu iliyonse; /vault achinsinsi amasintha mawu achinsinsi.
vaultDisable: Kuletsa vault ya akaunti iliyonse? Kutsimikizika kumafunika. Mbiri, mafayilo, kulumikizana, makiyi, zolemba ndi makonzedwe a osatsegula payekha adzabwerera ku vault-off storage.
vaultFailed: Ntchito ya vault idalephera. Onani mawu achinsinsi ndi kusungirako; palibe kugwa kwa plaintext komwe kumaloledwa.
vaultRecovery: Iyi si mawu achinsinsi /lock. Ngati mwaiwalika, bwezeretsani chizindikiritso chanu pogwiritsa ntchito mawu anu achire pakukhazikitsa kwatsopano. Magawo a vault omwe alipo sangathe kubwezeretsedwa popanda mawu achinsinsi awa.
vaultOldTabs: Tsekani ma tabu akale a Breeze musanasinthe vault.
vaultBackupOnly: Pamene vault imathandizidwa, zogulitsa kunja zimakhala ndi zithunzi zokhazokha za vault. Zowonjezera zowonjezera, mtambo, zodziwikiratu ndi zida zobwezeretsa zimalemala.
opScope: Sinthanitsani chizindikiritso ichi kumaitanira njira zonse ziwiri pamasom'pamaso. Zimatha mu mphindi 30. Yerekezerani zala pa zipangizo zonse ziwiri ndikutsimikizira pokhapokha ngati zikugwirizana. Sungani pulogalamuyi yotseguka mpaka /rendezvous itamaliza; Kubwezeretsanso kumachotsa kudikirira kuphatikiza. Palibe dzina loyang'ana kapena kutsimikizira.
opMatches: Ndinayerekeza zipangizo zonse ziwiri: zala zimagwirizana
opCompare: Yerekezerani chala ichi pazida zonse ziwiri. Imamanga makiyi onse achinsinsi, kusaina makiyi ndikuyitanitsa nonces.
opConfirmed: Lumikizanani kutsimikiziridwa. Tsegulani macheza awo ndikusinthana ma code /rendezvous. Mauthenga amatsegulidwa pambuyo pa chitsimikizo cha kiyi yachinsinsi.
opInvalid: Kugwirizanitsa pa intaneti kunalephera: zosayenera, kutha ntchito, zogwiritsidwa ntchito kapena zosagwirizana ndi code / kiyi, kapena cryptography yosathandizidwa. Chotsani kulumikizana kodikirira ndikusinthanitsa maitanidwe atsopano.
opPending: Malizitsani kugwirizanitsa pa intaneti ndi /rendezvous musanatumize. Gwiritsani ntchito /offlinepair kuletsa kuti muchotse.
opCancelled: Kuyembekezera kugwirizanitsa pa intaneti kwaletsedwa. Sinthanitsani maitanidwe atsopano pazida zonse ziwiri kuti muyesenso.
rvScope: Amafuna gawo lachinsinsi lomwe lilipo kapena pempho lotsimikizika /offlinepair. Sinthani zizindikiro zolumikizira payekha ndi QR kapena kukopera / kumata; zimatha mu mphindi 10.
rvQRTooLarge: Khodi iyi ndi yayikulu kwambiri kwa QR imodzi. Gwiritsani ntchito kukopera / kumata m'malo mwake.
rvScanUnavailable: Kusanthula kwa QR kwa kamera sikupezeka mu msakatuli uyu. Gwiritsani ntchito kukopera / kumata m'malo mwake.
rvReady: Code yokonzekera / yogwiritsidwa ntchito. Lembani kwa mnzanu, kapena lembani yankho lawo.
rvCopyFallback: Kope silikupezeka. Sankhani ndi kukopera kachidindo pamanja.
rvTrust: Lumikizani kamodzi kudzera mu kulandirana ndikutsimikizira kulumikizana uku, kapena kumaliza /offlinepair poyamba. Chinsinsi chosaina chokhochedwa ndi gawo kapena kutsimikiziridwa kodikirira pairing kumafunika.
rvInvalid: Chinsinsi cholumikizira kachidindo kapena njira yolakwika yosinthanitsa.
rvExpired: Khodi yolumikizana iyi yatha. Pangani yatsopano.
rvReplay: Khodi yolumikizana iyi yagwiritsidwa ntchito kale.

Pa chipangizo chatsopano, sankhani njira yobwezeretsa pazenera loyamba ndikulowetsa mawu anu achire - kapena dzina la akaunti yanu ndi passphrase. 3. Pamene chizindikiritso chanu chabwerera, zosunga zobwezeretsera pa kulandirana kwanu zimapezeka zokha ndikupatsidwa kuti mubwezeretsedwe. Palibe zingwe kapena mafayilo omwe amafunikira.

recoveryPhraseDesc: Kuwonetsedwa kamodzi. Ndi mawu awa ndi mawu anu achire, akauntiyi ikhoza kubwezeretsedwa pa chipangizo chatsopano - ndi aliyense amene ali ndi zonsezi, choncho sungani kwinakwake kotetezeka. Breeze sangawonetsenso izi kapena kukubwezeretsani.

toastRecoveryBadPhrase: Amenewa si mawu omveka ochiritsira — fufuzani mawuwo ndi kuyesanso.
toastRecoveryKitFailed: Sindinathe kutsegula zida zobwezeretsa - mawu kapena mawu achinsinsi sagwirizana.
toastRecoveryUnavailable: Mawu obwezeretsa sakupezeka pakali pano - bwezeretsani ndikuyesanso.
toastRecoveryKitCreated: Zida zobwezeretsa zatsitsidwa. Zimangotsegulidwa ndi mawu anu obwezeretsa ndi mawu achinsinsi - sungani pamodzi.
toastRecoveryHasIdentity: Chipangizochi chili kale ndi chizindikiritso - kubwezeretsa mawu ndikungoyambira mwatsopano.
toastRecoveryMismatch: Mawu amenewo ndi mawu achinsinsi sali a ID iyi ya Breeze - palibe chomwe chinabwezeretsedwa.
toastRecoveryNoneKit: Chizindikiritso ichi chimatayidwa (palibe kuchira), kotero zida zobwezeretsa sizingapangidwe.
simpleDesc: Zosunga zobwezeretsera zanu zachinsinsi zidzasungidwa pa kulandirana komwe mumayendetsa kapena kugwirizana - izi siziperekedwa konse pa kulandirana kosakhulupirika. Pa chipangizo chatsopano, dzina la akaunti yanu + passphrase imabweretsa akaunti yonse, popanda mawu oti mulembe. Ndi ofooka kuposa mawu achira: aliyense amene amayendetsa kulandirana kumeneko amagwira ciphertext ndipo amatha kuwona kuti akauntiyi ili ndi zosunga zobwezeretsera ndipo ikasintha, ndipo mawu oyerekeza amatsegula. Kulandirana sikungawerenge konse - mawu achinsinsi okha ndi omwe angathe. Sankhani yaitali.
simpleNewDesc: Sankhani dzina la akaunti yobwezeretsa - monga adilesi ya imelo, ndipo muyenera kukumbukira ndendende - ndi mawu achinsimo obwezeretsa a zilembo zosachepera 8. Pamodzi amatenga ndikutsegula zosunga zobwezeretsera zanu pa chipangizo chatsopano. Palibe amene amatumizidwa ku kulandirana; zokhazokha zomwe amatsegula ndi.
simpleSaved: Ndazindikira dzina la akaunti ndi passphrase
simpleAccountMin: Dzina la akaunti yobwezeretsa liyenera kukhala ndi zilembo zosachepera 3 (zilembo, manambala, _ kapena -).
simplePassMin: Mawu obwezeretsa ayenera kukhala osachepera zilembo 8.
simpleEnrolled: Kuchira kosavuta kuli pa. Zosunga zobwezeretsera zanu zachinsinsi zimasungidwa pa kulandirana kwanu.
simpleEnrolledUntil: Kuchira kosavuta kuli pa. Kulandirana kumasunga zosunga zobwezeretsera mpaka {0} - sinthani kuchokera /backup isanafike.
simpleNotFound: Palibe zosunga zobwezeretsera zomwe zimapezeka pa dzina la akaunti ndi passphrase. Fufuzani zonsezi ndendende ndikuyesanso.
simpleNotEnrolled: Kuchira kosavuta sikunakhazikitsidwe chifukwa cha chizindikiritso ichi.
simpleRestoreDesc: Lowetsani dzina la akaunti yobwezeretsa ndi passphrase yomwe mwasankha. Zosunga zobwezeretsera zimatengedwa kuchokera ku kulandirana uku ndikutsegulidwa pa chipangizochi chokha.
simplePassChangeDesc: Mawu achinsinsi awa amatchula kagawo kosiyana ndi kagawo kosunga zobwezeretsera kwanu kwamakono kumakhalamo. Zosunga zobwezeretsera zakale zimakhala pansi pa mawu akale mpaka kutha (masiku 90); kubwezeretsa kudzafunika mawu atsopano a passphrase. Pitirizani pokhapokha ngati kusintha kumeneku kunali kwadala.

migrateHtml:
Migrate from LINE / WhatsApp / Telegram
Step 1: Invite contacts (1-on-1)
Type /invite to copy an invite message → paste in LINE/WhatsApp
Type /qr to show a QR code → let them scan it
Step 1b: Move a whole group
Type /newgroup Your Group Name → generates an invite link
→ Paste the link in your LINE/WhatsApp group
→ Members just open the link to join automatically
Step 2: Import chat history
LINE: Chat → Settings → Send chat history → save .txt file
WhatsApp: Chat → More → Export chat → .txt
Telegram: Settings → Advanced → Export data → JSON
Type /import and select the file, or drag-drop onto the chat area
Step 3: Set up notifications
Allow browser notifications to get alerts for new messages
Add to Home Screen for an app-like experience

nicknameLocalNote: Mayina otchulidwa amasungidwa pa chipangizochi chokha. Iwo samatumizidwa konse ku kulumikizana kapena kulandirana.

helpSetSaveDisplayName: Amasunga dzina lowonetsera m'munda ndikugawana mbiri yanu yosinthidwa ndi omwe pulogalamu yawo imathandizira mbiri. Dzinali limathandiza anthu kukuzindirani; si chizindikiritso chapadera.
helpSetKtBlock: Amatseka gawo latsopano lachinsinsi ngati mbiri yowonekera kwa kiyi ikuwoneka yosinthidwa kapena unyolo wake wosungidwa sugwirizananso. Izi ndi zotetezeka kuposa chenjezo lokha, koma zitha kukulepheretsani kutumiza mauthenga mpaka kusintha kwa kiyi kutsimikiziridwa kapena makonzedwe atsekedwa.
helpSetBackup: Amapanga zosunga zobwezeretsera zachinsinsi pa kulandirana kwanu pamene kusungirako zosunga zobwezeretsera kulipo. The kulandirana amasunga kokha ciphertext, koma kuiwala passphrase zikutanthauza zosunga zobwezeretsera sangathe kubwezeretsedwa.
helpSetRestore: Amapeza zosunga zobwezeretsera zachinsinsi za akaunti iyi pa ma relays anu apanyumba ndikubwezeretsanso mutalowa mawu ofunikira a passphrase. Kubwezeretsa kumalowa m'malo mwa deta pa chipangizochi, choncho gwiritsani ntchito mosamala.
helpSetAutoBackup: Imasunga zokha zosunga zobwezeretsera zachinsinsi pambuyo poti deta yanu yasintha. Iwo kokha akuthamanga pambuyo inu kulowa zosunga zobwezeretsera passphrase pa chipangizochi, ndipo pokhapokha ngati kulandirana wanu amapereka zosunga zosunga zobwezeretsera yosungirako.
helpSetAutobackupArm: Amakulolani kuti mulowetse mawu osunga zobwezeretsera kamodzi kuti zosunga zobwezeretsera zokha zitha kuthamanga pagawoli. Mawu achinsinsi amasungidwa pokumbukira kokha, kotero mungafunike kulowanso pambuyo pobwezeretsanso pulogalamuyi.
helpSetMigrateDevice: Amatsegula chitsogozo cha sitepe ndi sitepe chosunthira akauntiyi ku chipangizo china pogwiritsa ntchito mawu anu achire kapena akaunti yobwezeretsa ndi passphrase. Chizindikiritso chanu sichikopedwa mpaka mutamaliza masitepe obwezeretsa pa chipangizo chatsopano.
helpSetHideRr: Amasiya kutumiza malisiti owerengedwa mukamatsegula macheza amodzi. Otumiza sadzawona mukawerenga mauthenga awo; Mauthenga enieniwo amafikabe mwachizolowezi.
helpSetHideTyping: Amasiya kutumiza chizindikiro cholembera pamene mukulemba. Ochezera anu sadzawona pamene mukulemba yankho, koma mutha kuwonabe zawo ngati agawana nawo.
helpSetRelayOnly: Njira zoyendetsera mayendedwe a anzawo kudzera pa ma seva a relay m'malo mwa kulumikizana mwachindunji, kubisa adilesi yanu ya IP kuchokera kwa omwe akugwirizana nawo. Ikhoza kupanga mafoni ndi kusamutsidwa kwa mafayilo pang'onopang'ono kapena kulephera pamene palibe kulandirana kogwiritsidwa ntchito, ndipo woyendetsa kulandirana amatha kuwonabe metadata yolumikizana.
helpSetNotifSound: Amasewera phokoso lalifupi pamene uthenga kapena foni yomwe imaloledwa kukudziwitsani ifika. Zidziwitso zowoneka ndizosiyana, ndipo Focus mode kapena macheza osalankhula amatha kuchenjezabe machenjezo.
helpSetSendSound: Amasewera phokoso lalifupi mukamatumiza uthenga. Ndi chitsimikizo chakomweko chabe ndipo sizikutanthauza kuti munthu winayo walandira kapena kuwerenga.
helpSetTabVisCalls: Amasonyeza kapena kubisa tabu ya Calls mu bar ya tabu yapansi. Kubisa sikuchotsa mbiri ya kuyitana kapena kuletsa kuyitanidwa.
helpSetTabVisContacts: Imasonyeza kapena kubisa tabu ya Contacts mu bar ya tabu yapansi. Kubisa sikuchotsa kulumikizana kwanu kapena macheza.
helpSetTabVisSelf: Amasonyeza kapena kubisa tabu ya Mbiri mu bar yapansi ya tabu. Mbiri yanu imakhalabe yopezeka, ndipo izi sizisintha ngati zimagawidwa.
helpSetTabVisSettings: Amasonyeza kapena kubisa tabu ya Zikhazikiko mu bar ya tabu yapansi. Ngati mukuzibisa mukamagwiritsa ntchito Zikhazikiko, Breeze imabwerera ku Chats; Zoikamo zimakhalabe zopezeka kuchokera ku batani la zoikamo kapena malamulo.
helpSetCallHistoryLog: Amasunga mndandanda wakomweko wa maulendo otuluka, omwe akubwera, ndi omwe adaphonya pa chipangizochi. Zimitsani kuti musiye zolemba zatsopano zoyimbira pano; sichichotsa mbiri yomwe yasungidwa kale.
helpSetAutoLock: Ngati mawu achinsinsi a pulogalamu-lock akhazikitsidwa, amatseka Breeze mukamasintha kuchoka pa tabu yake. Mudzafunika mawu achinsinsi amenewo mukabwerera; Izi sizilowa m'malo mwa kutseka chipangizocho.
helpSetNotifPerm: Amafunsa msakatuli kapena dongosolo loyendetsa kuti lipereke chilolezo chowonetsa zidziwitso. Mphepo sangathe kupereka izi zokha; Ngati chilolezo chinakanidwa kale, mungafunike kuchisintha mu msakatuli kapena makonzedwe a dongosolo.
helpSetShowPeerName: Amasonyeza dzina lomwe munthu wolumikizana naye adadzisankhira okha pambali pa dzina lomwe mudawapatsa. Izi zimangosintha zomwe mukuwona kwanuko; palibe chowonjezera chomwe chimatumizidwa ku kulumikizana kapena kulandirana.
helpSetAddRelay: Amawonjezera kulandirana kwina kunyumba atawonetsa zala zake kuti atsimikizire. Zowonjezera kunyumba zimatha kusintha kupezeka, koma aliyense amatha kuwona metadata monga nthawi komanso kuchuluka kwa magalimoto achinsinsi omwe amadutsamo.
helpSetRemoveRelay: Amachotsa imodzi yowonjezera kunyumba kulandirana kuchokera mndandanda wa chipangizochi. Kulandirana kumasunga ciphertext yomwe idalandira kale mpaka kutha kwachibadwa; kuchotsedwa kumangoletsa makope amtsogolo kugwiritsa ntchito kulandirana kumeneko.
helpSetFanout: Kwa anthu omwe amagwiritsa ntchito ma relays angapo apanyumba, amatumiza kope lililonse la uthenga kwa izi ambiri mwa ma relays amenewo. Makope ambiri akhoza kusintha yobereka ngati kulandirana wina ali pansi, koma iwo ntchito zambiri maukonde magalimoto ndi kusunga ciphertext m'malo ambiri.
helpSetPowerMode: Imayang'anira momwe Breeze imachepetsera kufufuza zam'mbuyo kuti ipulumutse batri. Kutumiza sikuchedwa, koma Saver ndi Emergency amatha kupanga mauthenga omwe akubwera ndi zosintha za kukhalapo zifike pambuyo pake; Auto amatsatira batri yanu pamene msakatuli akufotokoza.
helpSetRrDelay: Amadikira pafupifupi mphindi ziwiri, ndi kusiyana pang'ono mwachisawawa, asanatumize chiphaso chowerengedwa. Izi zimapangitsa kuti nthawi yanu yeniyeni yowerenga ikhale yosalongosoka, koma otumiza pamapeto pake amaphunzirabe kuti uthengawo udawerengedwa.
helpSetFocus: Amatsegula njira ya Focus kwa ola limodzi. Machenjezo ambiri a mauthenga amatsekedwa pamene akuyenda; Kulumikizana kwa VIP ndi kutchulidwa kumatha kukudziwitsani pokhapokha ngati njira yokhwima ili pa.
helpSetFocusStrict: Amachotsa VIP ndikutchula zosiyana mu Focus mode, kotero zidziwitso za uthenga zimakhala chete kwa aliyense. Phokoso la mphete lobwera limaponderezedwanso, ngakhale dongosolo lanu lingasonyezebe chidziwitso chowoneka.
helpSetRestoreFile: Imabwezeretsa zosunga zobwezeretsera zachinsinsi kuchokera ku fayilo yomwe mudasunga kale. Mukufunikira mawu osunga zobwezeretsera, ndipo deta yobwezeretsedwa imalowa m'malo mwa zomwe zili pa chipangizochi.
helpSetInviteFriend: Amapanga ulalo kapena uthenga womwe wina angagwiritse ntchito kukuwonjezerani pa Breeze. Aliyense amene ali ndi ulalowu angathe kuugwiritsa ntchito, choncho gawani ndi munthu yemwe mukufuna kuitana.
helpSetMigrateApps: Amatsegula chitsogozo chosunthira anthu kapena magulu kuchokera ku LINE, WhatsApp, kapena Telegalamu kupita ku Breeze, kuphatikizapo kulowetsa mbiri yakale ya macheza. Mbiri yobweretsedwa ili ndi zomwe pulogalamu ina idatumiza kunja.
cfStatusSaved: Chizindikiro chosungidwa pa chipangizochi, koma sichinatsimikizidwebe.
cfStatusConnectedNoAccounts: Chizindikiro chotsimikiziridwa. Chizindikiro cha chizindikiro: {0}; Palibe maakaunti omwe amawoneka ku chizindikiro ichi.
cfErrNoProxy: Kukhazikitsa kwa Cloudflare kumafunikira kulandirana kwa Breeze yokonzedwa kwa proxy ya API. Onjezerani kulandirana kunyumba choyamba, kapena kudziletsa Breeze ndi kuthamanga kukhazikitsa kumeneko.
cfErrNoToken: palibe chizindikiro cha Cloudflare chomwe chimapulumutsidwa
cfErrStorage: Sindinathe kupeza malo osungirako pa chipangizo
cfErrTokenRequired: phata chizindikiro cha Cloudflare API choyamba
cfSaved: Chizindikiro cha Cloudflare chosungidwa pa chipangizochi.
cfDisconnected: Kulumikizana kwa Cloudflare kuchotsedwa pa chipangizochi.
cfNote: Chizindikirocho chimasungidwa pa chipangizochi chokha. Zopempha za msakatuli zimadutsa mopanda boma kudzera mu /api / cf-proxy ya chiyambi ichi ku API ya Cloudflare popanda kulowa kapena kusungidwa. Ma relays otsimikiziridwa omwe ali ndi kiyi wotumizira amawonjezeredwa ku Home Relays zokha.
helpSetCloudflareSave: Amasunga chizindikiro cha Cloudflare API pokhapokha mu sitolo yokonzekera ya IndexedDB ya chipangizochi. Imatumizidwa kokha ku Cloudflare's API ngati chizindikiro cha Bearer, osati ku Breeze relays. Kukhazikitsa kwa seva kumafunikira chizindikiro chokhala ndi akaunti yowerengedwa (mndandanda wa maakaunti), Zolemba za Ogwira Ntchito, ndi zilolezo zosintha za Workers KV Storage.
helpSetCloudflareVerify: Amatcha kutsimikiziridwa kwa chizindikiro cha Cloudflare ndi mndandanda wa akaunti APIs ndi chizindikiro chosungidwa pa chipangizochi, kenako akuwonetsa chizindikiro chenicheni ndi mayina a akaunti kapena cholakwika chenicheni. Chizindikirocho chimatumizidwa kokha ku API ya Cloudflare. Kukhazikitsa kwa seva kumafunikira kuwerengedwa kwa akaunti (mndandanda wa maakaunti), Zolemba za Ogwira Ntchito, ndi Ogwira Ntchito KV Storage kusintha zilolezo.
helpSetCloudflareDisconnect: Amachotsa chizindikiro chosungidwa cha Cloudflare API kuchokera ku sitolo ya makonzedwe a IndexedDB a chipangizochi ndikuchotsa boma lolumikizana lomwe likuwonetsedwa. Sichichotsa chizindikirocho, ndipo sichichotsa Wogwira Ntchito, dzina la KV, kapena chinthu china chilichonse kuchokera ku akaunti yanu ya Cloudflare.
cfSetupDone: Seva yokonzeka komanso yoyang'aniridwa ndi thanzi: {0}. Onjezerani ngati kulandirana kunyumba kuchokera ku gawo la Relays.
cfSetupUnverified: Wogwira ntchito adatumizidwa ku {0}, koma cheke chaumoyo sichinayankhe ({1}). Onjezerani ngati kulandirana kunyumba pokhapokha mutayang'ana.
cfErrNoAccount: palibe akaunti ya Cloudflare yomwe ikuwoneka ku chizindikiro ichi
cfErrWorkerSource: sindinathe kutsitsa gwero la ogwira ntchito ophatikizidwa
helpSetCloudflareSetup: Amapanga kapena kugwiritsanso ntchito dzina la KV la mphepo, amakweza Breeze Worker yophatikizidwa ngati script ya mphepo yokhala ndi KV yofunikira, imathandizira adilesi yake ya workers.dev, ndikuyang'ana /api / thanzi. Chizindikirocho chimafunikira kuwerengedwa kwa akaunti (mndandanda wa maakaunti), Zolemba za Ogwira Ntchito, ndi Ogwira Ntchito KV Kusungirako kusintha. URL ya seva imasungidwa pa chipangizochi chokha; onjezerani ngati kulandirana kunyumba kuchokera ku Relays ngati mukufuna kuigwiritsa ntchito. Kukhazikitsa sikukonzekera zinsinsi zosankha za zidziwitso zokankhira, TURN, kapena kiyi ya chizindikiritso cha kulandirana, kotero zinthuzo zimakhala kutali kapena mu kugwa kwawo kosakhulupirika mpaka kukonzedwa mu dashboard ya Cloudflare.
lnSimilar: "{0}" imafanana ndi "{1}" yomwe ilipo ({2}). Yerekezerani zala musanakhulupirire dzinali.
lnUnsafe: "{0}" ili ndi zilembo zobisika / zowongolera kapena chisakanizo choopsa cha zolemba. Yerekezerani zala musanakhulupirire dzinali.
cfGuideText: Pangani chizindikiro cha API ndi Zikhazikiko za Akaunti: Werengani, Zolemba za Ogwira Ntchito: Sinthani, ndi Ogwira Ntchito KV Kusungirako: Sinthani, kenako ikani pansipa.
helpSetCloudflareQuick: Amapulumutsa chizindikiro chomata cha Cloudflare API pa chipangizochi, amatsimikizira akauntiyo, amapanga dzina la KV ndi subdomain workers.dev ngati pakufunika, amagwiritsa ntchito Breeze Worker, ndikuyang'ana /api / thanzi mu sitepe imodzi.

helpSetTabOrder: Amasintha dongosolo la ma tabu apansi. Kokani mzere, kapena gwiritsani ntchito mabatani a muvi; Bar ya tabu imasintha nthawi yomweyo. Macheza amatha kukonzedwanso koma nthawi zonse amawonetsedwa.
helpSetInstallApp: Amatsegula kukhazikitsa pulogalamu kamodzi-kudina pamene msakatuli amapereka. Ngati prompt imeneyo sakupezeka, ikuwonetsa malangizo okhazikitsa kapena chikwangwani chotsitsa kompyuta m'malo mwake.
